Free and open source

Stop paying for a scribe.

Free for one vet or a whole hospital. Open source under Apache-2.0, on GitHub. No lock-in.

  • No subscription and no per-visit fees
  • No account needed, no contract, no seat count
  • Notes copy cleanly into the practice software you already use

Built carefully

Quick to draft, careful enough to sign.

  • Every line links to what was said

    Tap a sentence in the note to see the moment it came from, and hear it.

    Draft note, exam

    Weight 12.6 kg, unchanged

    Vet Her weight today is 12.6 kilos, the same as last time. 00:21

  • Numbers are checked

    A weight or dose that isn't in the transcript blocks signing until you fix it.

    12.6 kg 1.2 mg/kg, not said

  • A vet signs every note

    Nothing is final until you sign it, and a signed note is locked.

    Draft Signed

  • "Not discussed", never a guess

    A heading nobody talked about says so plainly instead of being filled in.

    Dental

    Not discussed

  • 20 templates built in

    General practice, specialties, farm, equine and exotics. Or build your own from plain headings.

    WellnessSick visitRecheckDentalSurgeryEquineExoticsCallback
